newsitem.title: USA: Applied Biometrics new system on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Applied Biometrics new system on schedule.

text.p: Applied Biometrics Inc said Friday it expected its next generation Cardiac Output Monitoring System to be available late in the third quarter.
The system will be used in the pediatric market and the adult market, which is considerably larger, the company said. Development of the monitoring system is on schedule.
Earlier Applied Biometrics said it had a net loss of $613,523, or $0.15 a share, in the second quarter compared to a loss of $297,053, or $0.07 a share, in the same period last year.
